name: io.github.midhunxavier/opcua
title: OPC UA MCP Server
description: Connect MCP clients to OPC UA sensors, history, subscriptions, events and alarms.

environmentVariables.name: OPCUA_SERVER_URL
environmentVariables.description: OPC UA endpoint, including its path. For the local plant mock: opc.tcp://localhost:4840/freeopcua/server/.

environmentVariables.name: OPCUA_SECURITY_POLICY
environmentVariables.description: None for local mocks only. Set a supported policy and client certificate/key for encrypted connections.

environmentVariables.name: OPCUA_SECURITY_MODE
environmentVariables.description: Sign or SignAndEncrypt with a security policy; defaults to SignAndEncrypt when a policy is set.

environmentVariables.name: OPCUA_CLIENT_CERT
environmentVariables.description: Local path to the client certificate required by the configured security policy.

environmentVariables.name: OPCUA_CLIENT_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Local path to the matching private key; do not paste key material into this field.

environmentVariables.name: OPCUA_APPLICATION_URI
environmentVariables.description: Optional application URI override; otherwise derived from the client certificate.

environmentVariables.name: OPCUA_USERNAME
environmentVariables.description: Optional OPC UA username. Omit for an anonymous session.

environmentVariables.name: OPCUA_PASSWORD
environmentVariables.description: Password for OPCUA_USERNAME. Configure a security policy to protect credentials in transit.
